## Meridian Tidal Pilot - Final Operations Review Summary

Turbine T-4 suffered a multi-week outage after its bearing seal corroded through, allowing seawater into the nacelle. The root cause was traced to corrosion of the bearing seal housing.

The pilot delivered **18.7 GWh** over 24 months, which was 6 percent below the original 19.9 GWh forecast.

The project cost **EUR 41.25 million against a budget of EUR 36.7 million — an overrun of EUR 4.55 million (12.4%)**, driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign.

An independent fish-monitoring programme found **no statistically significant change** in fish migration counts before and after installation (p = 0.41).

Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing titanium fasteners with duplex stainless steel on all remaining nacelles; this was **accepted in principle** by the steering group.

The final decision: the steering group **approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026**, contingent on a completed bearing seal redesign and a successful dry-dock endurance test.
